info.name: Offline Ride Cashback Offer — /offers/list/v2 promo card (eligible → card, used → none)
info.description: Cash ride with the first-ride CASHBACK offer, driven through the new GET /offers/list/v2. The collection installs the city's CUMULATIVE_OFFER_POLICY rule with a `promoCard` under an "offers not empty" condition (the rule uses only `if`, `in`, `map`, `var`, `cat`, all used by production rules), then asserts: a fresh rider gets the eligible offers plus the card from v2 (same offers as v1, every offer typed), the estimate carries the same card through unchanged (no `source` input to the rule), v1 is unaffected, the ride completes with the cashback applied, and afterwards v2 lists no offer and `promoCard` is null while the response shape stays intact. The rider is registered under `bap_short_id` at the search origin so the rule installed for that merchant and city is the one the person-based v2 call resolves. Needs `bap_dashboard_url` / `bap_dashboard_token` in the env.
